# DevShelf - Complete Free Developer Tools Knowledge Base (Full Catalog)

### AgentShield
- **Category**: AI Agent Security & Defense
- **Pricing Model**: See official site for free access and limits
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Language**: TypeScript / Node.js
- **URL**: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
- **DevShelf Dossier**: https://devshelf.ritualdev.in/tools/agentshield.html
- **Description**: Zero-leak secret interception, deterministic Shannon entropy tokenization, AST shell command sandbox, and CI/CD security gate for Claude Code, Cursor, and autonomous AI agents.
